ITEM 1 | Dark brown, smooth-surfaced rounded pieces, three chunks about 2.5 cm across stacked near the top-left of the plate, slightly glossy with a uniform matte-to-sheen skin, firm and holding shape, no visible grill marks | 45
ITEM 2 | Yellow-orange cubes and wedges of pineapple, about 2 cm pieces with cut faces showing pale yellow flesh and slightly darker rind edges, moist and firm, scattered across the left and center of the plate | 130
ITEM 3 | Whole and halved red strawberries, glossy red with seed-dotted surface, halves about 3 cm long with pale white cores, moist and juicy, clustered in the right-center of the plate | 95
ITEM 4 | Small dark blueberries, about 1 cm diameter, deep blue-black with a slight bloom sheen, whole and scattered among the strawberries and near the cheese | 15
ITEM 5 | Off-white soft cheese, crumbly and cubed with irregular chunks about 1.5 to 2.5 cm, matte, slightly moist surface, piled on the upper-right edge of the plate | 85
